title: Avatar
summary: Canonical identity family with a base Avatar component, two scoped compositions, and thin semantic wrappers for profile, presence, and team contexts.
useWhen: The UI needs a person or member identity surface with stable size, content-type, and semantic behavior.
The product flow maps clearly to ProfileAvatar, PresenceAvatar, or TeamAvatarGroup and benefits from canonical purpose metadata.
The team wants React and Vue avatar behavior to stay aligned through shared contracts and the central semantic registry.
avoidWhen: The surface really needs an interactive profile menu, upload flow, or editable identity control rather than a static avatar family member.
The implementation cannot provide truthful alt text or aria labeling for a non-decorative identity surface.
The team expects avatar-group layouts beyond the current stacked medium pattern and overflow counter defined by the shipped family.
recommendationDescription: Choose the purpose wrapper that matches the meaning; use Avatar as the deliberate primitive escape hatch.

recommendedComponents.name: ProfileAvatar
recommendedComponents.description: A person's identity image, initials, or icon fallback

recommendedComponents.name: PresenceAvatar
recommendedComponents.description: An avatar with an online, away, or offline status indicator

recommendedComponents.name: TeamAvatarGroup
recommendedComponents.description: A compact overlapping group of members with an overflow count

recommendedComponents.name: Avatar
recommendedComponents.description: Base avatar for custom contexts; the deliberate escape hatch
